content.title: Interactive Encyclopedia | Creature Menu Switching
content.summary: Keep the menu, data panel, and main viewport fixed while a visible selector moves through the entries. Each selection must update the name, parameters, viewport subject, and one signature action in sync.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed selector menu + fixed data panel + fixed main viewport + at least 4 original entries + visible selection change + synchronized fields + one signature action per entry
quick_start.recommended_input: The fixed weather drone encyclopedia sequentially selects five original drones. Each time, the selector is moved first, then the call sign, wind parameters, and main window are updated simultaneously, and the new drone completes a defined action in the corresponding weather chamber.
required_anchors: The positions of the menu, data area, and main window are fixed.
A visible selection must occur before each content change.
The name, parameters, and subject are updated synchronously.
Each selected subject completes a defined action.
The ending retains the final selection state intact.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The menu, data panel, and main viewport stay fixed while the selector moves entry by entry. Each selection updates the name, parameters, and viewport subject in sync, and the selected subject performs one defined action.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep one information interface and spatial grid fixed while a visible selector chooses one item at a time. Each selection must update the title, concise attributes and one large live viewport together; the selected subject then performs one short behavior that proves the new state before the next choice.

invariants.rule: Keep one selector grid, one data zone and one live viewport fixed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Moving interface regions make updates difficult to compare.

invariants.rule: Show one visible selector action before every content change.
Update title, attributes and live subject as one synchronized state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Partial updates make the catalog feel broken.

invariants.rule: Give each selected subject one short defining behavior.
invariants.purpose: Proves more than a static thumbnail.
invariants.ablation_failure: Idle subjects do not justify a live viewport.

invariants.rule: End on a held complete state with selector and selected subject both visible.
invariants.purpose: Lets the viewer verify the final choice.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting away immediately removes the proof relation.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the exact source grid and cursor path
